# wedos_dns_record_set (Resource)

All values of one name and type in a WEDOS DNS zone. Each value is stored by WEDOS as a separate row.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "wedos_dns_record_set" "www" {
  zone    = "example.cz"
  name    = "www"
  type    = "A"
  ttl     = 300
  records = ["192.0.2.10", "192.0.2.11"]
}

# Apex records use an empty name.
resource "wedos_dns_record_set" "mx" {
  zone    = "example.cz"
  name    = ""
  type    = "MX"
  ttl     = 3600
  records = ["10 mx1.example.net", "20 mx2.example.net"]
}

# ALIAS points the zone apex at a host name, e.g. a CDN distribution.
resource "wedos_dns_record_set" "apex" {
  zone    = "example.cz"
  name    = ""
  type    = "ALIAS"
  ttl     = 300
  records = ["d111111abcdef8.cloudfront.net"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name relative to the zone; "" for the apex.
- `records` (Set of String) Record data in WEDOS rdata format, one element per value.
- `ttl` (Number) Seconds, 300–172800 (the range WEDOS accepts).
- `type` (String) Record type.
- `zone` (String) Name of the zone the record set belongs to.

### Optional

- `allow_overwrite` (Boolean) Adopt rows that already exist for this name and type on create, instead of failing.
- `author_comment` (String) Comment stored on every row. ASCII letters, digits and spaces only.

### Read-Only

- `fqdn` (String) Fully qualified name of the record set.
- `id` (String) zone/name/type, with @ for the apex.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A record set is imported as zone/name/type, with @ for the zone apex.
terraform import wedos_dns_record_set.www example.cz/www/A
terraform import wedos_dns_record_set.mx example.cz/@/MX
```
